def classify(n)
  if n < 0
    "negative"
  elsif n == 0
    "zero"
  else
    "positive"
  end
end

def check(a, b)
  unless a && b
    return false
  end
  a || b
end

def check_word_form(a, b)
  a and b
  a or b
end

def loop_while(n)
  i = 0
  while i < n
    i += 1
  end
  i
end

def loop_until(n)
  i = 0
  until i >= n
    i += 1
  end
  i
end

def loop_for(items)
  total = 0
  for item in items
    total += item
  end
  total
end

def pick(flag, x, y)
  flag ? x : y
end

def modifier_forms(x)
  return x if x.nil?
  x += 1 while x < 10
  x
end

def elseif_probe
  elseif
end

case "a"
when "a"
  puts "alpha"
when "b"
  puts "beta"
else
  puts "unknown"
end
